title: Porazili jsme Trumpa v Hormuzu i ve Washingtonu, zní z Teheránu
author: Martin Novák
first_paragraph: Historie se nikdy neopakuje úplně, ale někdy zčásti. Rok 2026 ale připomíná rok 1980.
last_paragraph: The Iranian nation handed Trump a strategic defeat on the battlefield and in the Hormuz—and a POLITICAL DEFEAT in Washington. Meanwhile, Americans got stuck with the bill for his war. Anyone who takes on Iran will pay the price—from the battlefield to their own doorstep.— محسن رضایی (@ir_rezaee) November 4, 2026
